items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Charlie Christian in the context of Snub Mosley's band, but the interviewee does not confirm personal interaction or relationship with Christian.

ctx.x: Yes, his family is in Hot Springs now, his sister.

He's the one who used to say, I got to find John Fielding, John Fielding has the scrapbook of the band, because John Fielding became his manager later on in the thirties, after the band broke up and he started the small band. He had the small band with Charlie Christian in 1937, '38, and John Fielding was his manager at that time.
You know something that we didn't go over at your house, that I played with Ethel Waters.
